Let me consider this question about Hans Holbein the Younger.

Hans Holbein the Younger (c. 1497-1543) was a German-Swiss artist who became one of the most important portrait painters of the 16th century. He is most famously associated with the English court, where he served as court painter to King Henry VIII from the 1530s until Holbein's death in 1543.

Holbein created many iconic portraits of Henry VIII, his wives, and members of the Tudor court. His work for Henry VIII is his most celebrated achievement and what he is primarily remembered for today.
